questions.prompt: Which document did Thomas Jefferson principally draft in 1776?
questions.fact: Congress cut roughly a quarter of his text, including a passage condemning the slave trade.

questions.prompt: Which scientist established the laws of inheritance by breeding pea plants?
questions.fact: His results were ignored for about thirty-five years before being independently rediscovered around 1900.

questions.prompt: Which sport awards a Maillot Jaune to its race leader?
questions.fact: The colour is often attributed to the yellow newsprint of the newspaper that founded the race.

questions.prompt: Which multiplayer game popularised the battle royale format alongside a dance-emote economy?
questions.fact: Its battle royale mode was added late in development to a game originally built around cooperative base defence.

questions.prompt: Which country has the most time zones including its overseas territories?
questions.fact: Its scattered overseas departments and territories span the globe, giving it more zones than any contiguous landmass could.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'One Hundred Years of Solitude'?
questions.fact: He reportedly sold his car to fund the writing and could only afford to post half the manuscript to the publisher.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Photoshop image editor?
questions.fact: Photoshop was written by two brothers, one of whom worked at Industrial Light & Magic. Adobe licensed it in 1988.
